snippet.title: Official Trailer | Delicious - Emily's Christmas Carol
snippet.description:
Enjoy Delicious, the award-winning cooking story game series! You'll get carried away by this exciting Christmas tale while cooking amazing dishes in wonderful kitchens. This 14nd season of the Famous Delicious story game series simply can't be missed. Merry cooking to all! ▶︎ Play now: http://m.onelink.me/5ac9e69e
